data_fields.name: timer_interval_s
data_fields.donor_constant: 60 default at subscribe (no per-timer rule beyond the minimum)

data_fields.name: restart_next_pass_s
data_fields.donor_constant: saved time to next pass, restored as start delay

best_idea: One timer per interval value, shared by every subscriber on that interval, with changes made during a pass applied after it, and a saved time-to-next-pass so a restart keeps the same phase.
decision_why: The shape fits zone timers (respawn, grace expiry, cooldowns) under row 23; the whole-second interval, the database storage and the object-based callbacks do not fit the fight.
acceptance: A server test in which a respawn timer subscribed during a pass first fires on its own interval and not in that pass, a throwing timer does not stop the others in its group, and a restart with 4 s left to the next pass fires that pass 4 s after restart.
